sections.label: Fire safety rules for residences
sections.summary: All residential premises in Singapore are subject to fire safety requirements regulated by the Singapore Civil Defence Force.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the
sentences.text: Minister for National Development): All residential premises in Singapore are subject to fire safety requirements regulated by the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

sections.label: Standards and higher occupancy cap
sections.summary: These standards remain sufficient with the temporary higher occupancy cap for larger private residential properties, facilitating firefighting and enhancing resident safety.

sentences.text: This facilitates firefighting while enhancing the safety of residents.

sections.label: Higher occupancy cap registration and monitoring
sections.summary: Fire safety standards remain sufficient with the temporary higher occupancy cap; owners of eligible larger private properties must register with URA for the higher cap, and MCSTs monitor liveability and fire safety standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: First of all, I would reiterate what I answered earlier: in terms of the standards as far as fire safety is concerned, they remain sufficient even with the temporary higher occupancy cap for larger private residential estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Just a few points with regard to the allowability of higher occupancy rates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: They are only applicable for larger private residential properties, at least 90 square kilometres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: [Please refer to ​"Clarification by Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development", Official Report, 25 February 2026, Vol 96, Issue 19, Correction By Written Statement section.] And that is the equivalent size of a typical four-room Housing and Development Board flat.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: I wish to assure the Member that for the owners of eligible properties, if they do wish to increase their occupancy cap, they must first register with the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) with a registration fee of $20 to qualify for the higher occupancy cap.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Therefore, any allowability for the increase in occupancy cap is registered with the URA and that becomes a point of monitoring of sorts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: With regard to dealing with the residents' liveability within the estates, the monitoring of that will come within the MCST of the condominiums to make sure that common spaces and corridors do adhere to the liveability standards or the fire safety standards as provided by SCDF.

sections.label: Reporting fire safety hazards
sections.summary: If residents highlight fire safety hazards to the authorities, inspections will ensue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: One would expect that if any resident were to be able to see that there are some fire safety hazards, that these will be highlighted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: And where they are highlighted to the authorities, inspections will ensue.
